memory_annotations.evidence_summary: Marcus explicitly chose coach only for this Dallas trip because the flight is short and the business-class premium was not worthwhile, providing a local exception to the business-first cabin preference.

messages.content: I need Dallas flights for the leadership meeting November 18 through 20. It starts Tuesday at 1:00 p.m. and ends Thursday at noon. Nonstop from Chicago, and do not book a hotel yet.
I’ll compare Tuesday morning departures and Thursday afternoon returns. Are you flying alone, and should I check both O’Hare–DFW and Midway–Love Field?
Just me. Check both airports. I need enough ground time to reach the opening session without cutting it close.

The strongest pair is Southwest from Midway to Love Field: Tuesday 7:05–9:35 a.m. and Thursday 3:10–5:30 p.m., nonstop, coach at $438 round trip. The fare includes two checked bags and can be changed without a fee, with any fare difference applying. From O’Hare, American has 7:30–10:10 a.m. to DFW and 3:25–5:55 p.m. back for $512 in main cabin or $846 in business. Both outbound choices leave roughly two hours or more before the session, depending on the venue.
Which is safer if the meeting ends right at noon Thursday?

The 3:10 p.m. Love Field return is workable if the venue is in central Dallas: leaving around 12:20 gives about 35 minutes to the airport and nearly two hours before departure. DFW would require a longer transfer, so the 3:25 p.m. flight provides less practical cushion despite leaving later.
Take the Midway option. For this trip coach is fine; it is a short flight and the business fare is not worth the extra cost. Is the outbound timing still comfortable if I allow for a rideshare delay?

Yes. Landing at 9:35 a.m. leaves three hours and 25 minutes before the opening. Even allowing 25 minutes to exit the airport, 20 minutes for a rideshare pickup, and up to 45 minutes in traffic, you should reach a central Dallas venue around 11:05 a.m.
Book that round trip. Use the flexible coach fare you described.

Booked for $438.00 on Southwest, confirmation K9R4DM: Tuesday, November 18, Midway to Dallas Love Field, 7:05–9:35 a.m.; Thursday, November 20, Love Field to Midway, 3:10–5:30 p.m. Both flights are nonstop. The fare includes two checked bags and no change fee; cancellation yields a flight credit under the ticket terms. Plan to reach Midway by 5:35 a.m. Tuesday. Once the meeting hotel or venue is confirmed, I’ll use these airport times to narrow the lodging area and Thursday departure timing.
